item.title: "Code was never the hard part" is an insult to all programmers
item.description:
📝 If coding is easy, why is software so damn buggy. Some software developers do say “I don't write code, I solve customer's problems”. I don't mean to imply there are no developers that simultaneously care deeply about the craft of software development and really empathize with the customer.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.senko.net/code-was-never-the-hard-part-is-an-insult-to-all-programmers

item.title: Triton: DirectX 11 Driver for QEMU
item.description:
📝 dll) Kernel mode Kernel-mode driver Hardware / Virtualization In Windows, the application communicates with the system Direct3D and DXGI libraries. That leaves us with the hard part. This is one of the reasons that QEMU has never got far with Windows GPU acceleration.
